summary: Reviewed cross-unit composition effects across 18 units sharing services/ paths. Multiple units modify distributed_hardware_service.cpp, component_manager.cpp, enable_task.cpp, and IPC stub/proxy. The key interaction concern is IPC serialization format changes (DHDescriptor parcel fields) introduced by merge-01b5c0c0fefa and merge-660ebe708b80 that could cause wire-format ABI breaks if old and new versions communicate. Another interaction is the removal and later re-introduction of CheckDHAccessPermission across merge-63c841fd613b and later commits, creating a security gap window. No new interaction defects beyond those already identified in individual unit reviews.

interactions.title: IPC serialization format drift across multiple units modifying DHDescriptor
interactions.causal_chain: merge-01b5c0c0fefa adds firstCallingTokenId field to DHDescriptor parcel; merge-660ebe708b80 adds further IPC proxy/stub changes to the same serialization path. The combined effect is a multi-step wire-format evolution that creates ABI incompatibility windows.
interactions.trigger: Old proxy (pre-tokenId) communicating with new stub (post-tokenId) across merge boundaries
interactions.impact: Parcel data misalignment causing IPC failure or data corruption
interactions.temporal_status: Current at scan HEAD; cumulative IPC format change
evidence: merge-01b5c0c0fefa adds ReadUint32/WriteUint32 for firstCallingTokenId in DHDescriptor
merge-660ebe708b80 further modifies IPC proxy/stub serialization
shared surface: distributed_hardware_proxy.cpp modified by both units

interactions.title: Security check removal and partial re-introduction across units
interactions.causal_chain: merge-63c841fd613b removes CheckDHAccessPermission from LoadSinkDMSDPService and NotifySinkRemoteSourceStarted. Later commits partially re-introduce combined checks but the gap existed at the merge boundary.
interactions.trigger: SA entry point called without access permission check during gap window
interactions.impact: Unauthorized access to distributed hardware SA methods during the gap period
interactions.temporal_status: Historical gap; later commits re-introduced permission checks but the security defect was present at scan HEAD during the review window
evidence: distributed_hardware_service.cpp modified by multiple units including merge-63c841fd613b
shared surface: distributed_hardware_service.h and .cpp across units

checked_safe: component_manager.cpp modifications across units are additive and do not conflict
enable_task.cpp changes are consistent across units that modify it
Build configuration changes across units do not conflict
